servicesTitle: Inside, outside, and every detail between.
servicesIntro: From a deep interior clean to multi-stage paint correction, with high-quality products for every surface.

services.name: Maintenance Detail
services.text: A hand wash, wheels and tires, interior vacuum and windows, finished with a ceramic detail spray.

services.name: Clay & Seal Detail
services.text: Hand wash, clay bar and iron removal, then an SiO2 sealant that protects paint for up to 8 to 10 months.

services.name: Interior Complete Detail
services.text: Deep-cleaned surfaces, steamed and shampooed carpet and cloth seats, steamed headliner and seatbelts.

services.name: Alpha Signature Detail
services.text: Our full inside-and-out detail with engine bay, SiO2 sealant for up to 12 months and trim restored.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: Semi-permanent protection that deepens color and keeps your vehicle cleaner, longer. Choose 1, 3 or 5 year protection.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.text: Machine polishing that removes swirls and defects, from a light enhancement to multi-stage correction.
